bid_summary:
bid_summary

The RFP requests a business to maintain a drug and alcohol-free workplace and comply with COMAR 21.11.08. It requires publishing a statement prohibiting drug and alcohol use, preventing employees from working under the influence, and not hiring individuals with drug abuse issues. The contract includes specific reporting requirements regarding criminal drug convictions. Contract duration is undefined.
